product.title: Premium Narrated Bus Tour of Bar Harbor and Acadia National Park (3.5 Hours)

description.text: Known for its rocky coastlines, wealth of wildlife, and evergreen forests, Acadia National Park promises dramatic scenery—and this fully narrated driving tour makes for an easy way to discover it. Your guide covers landmark stops such as Thunder Hole, Jordan Pond, Ocean Path, or Park Loop Road depending on the itinerary. Stops include Cadillac Mountain, Thunder Hole, Sieur de Monts Spring, Jordan Pond. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on coastal overlooks, carriage roads, and photography or adventure highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Bar Harbor who want a guided Acadia National Park experience without coordinating park logistics, trailheads, or carriage roads on their own.
